description: This PHP source file defines the TranslateClient class for interacting with the Amazon Translate service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method signatures for various translate-related operations and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: TranslateClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the Amazon Translate service, providing methods to perform translation and terminology management tasks.

methods.name: createParallelData
methods.description: Creates a parallel data resource for custom translation.

methods.name: createParallelDataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a parallel data resource.

methods.name: deleteParallelDataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a parallel data resource.

methods.name: describeTextTranslationJob
methods.description: Provides information about a text translation job.

methods.name: describeTextTranslationJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a translation job.

methods.name: getParallelData
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific parallel data resource.

methods.name: listLanguages
methods.description: Lists available languages supported by Amazon Translate.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags assigned to a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: startTextTranslationJob
methods.description: Starts a new text translation job.
